newFinding: v0.1 could not safely bootstrap a position that already existed when the ledger begins. v0.2 separates POSITION_BASELINE evidence from FILL evidence.

POSITION_BASELINE.meaning: Observed account+symbol holding state at the start of a ledger epoch; not a trade and not eligible for return/cost attribution.

pointInTimeSemantics: confirmedAt = first time the system may use the receipt as known evidence
a later correction does not rewrite earlier as-known research views
bootstrapRules: First FILL may start a ledger without baseline only when action=BUY and sharesBefore=0
ADD/REDUCE/SELL cannot be the first reconstructable event unless a valid POSITION_BASELINE exists
A baseline must never be converted into a synthetic BUY
accountScope: accountKey is required so the same symbol held in different accounts is not silently merged
implementationConclusion: Do not auto-convert existing /api/positions saves into fill events. A future Production implementation should use a separate append-only execution/baseline endpoint or broker import; /api/positions may remain a current snapshot/read model.
